_doc: Surgical per-effect corrections, merged by tools/preprocess.mjs AFTER parseEffectsFromDesc (PRE-P12-DATA-QUALITY.md §3). Keyed overrides.<resonatorId>.<slotKey>, where slotKey is 'S<level>.<index>' (chain) or 'IH<node>.<index>' (inherent). Only the listed fields change; the parser output is the base. Special fields: suppress:true drops the effect; an entirely new slotKey adds an effect the parser missed (supply a full effect object). Every slotKey must reference a real slot (data-integrity tested).

trigger.phrase: Ice Prism or Glacier detonated (Detonate cast / burst damage; kit text names only Ice Prism + Glacier, so Ice Thorn is excluded). Team ATK window; 'stacking up to 2 times' deliberately NOT modeled (scaleEffect's maxStacks fallback would flat-credit 2 stacks always — single-stack is the conservative floor)

IH0.0._resolvedVia: distinctApplicatorTierContribution (conditional-buffs.js) — Snow Rust 1-stack tier, now team-aware-gated instead of a manual toggle. 2026-06-28.

IH0.1._resolvedVia: Same as IH0.0 — was incorrectly unconditional; now folded into the same 1-stack tier.

IH0.2._resolvedVia: Same as IH0.0 — Snow Rust 3-stack tier.

trigger.phrase: Basic Attack hits a target (stacking Fusion DMG Bonus)

S1.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-05 Tier-1 override batch: 'When Basic Attack hits a target, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 3%, stacking up to 4 time(s) for 6s.' — clean castMatch(basic) with a resolvable stack trigger (same event stacks and refreshes).

trigger.phrase: True Sight Conquest/Charge hit, or Liberation cast (any grants Enflamement)

IH1.1._resolvedVia: distinctApplicatorTierContribution (conditional-buffs.js) — Tune Rupture 3-stack max-tier unlock, now team-aware-gated. 2026-06-28.

IH1.3._resolvedVia: Same as IH1.1 — Fusion Burst 2-stack max-tier unlock.

trigger.phrase: Forte Circuit Judgment Strike hits a target

S4.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-05 Tier-1 override batch: 'When Forte Circuit Judgment Strike hits a target, the ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 12s.' Team-wide propagation is handled separately by the existing TEAM_RECIPIENT_RE text match in buffs.js.

trigger.phrase: Intro Skill Loong's Halo (grants Immortal's Descendancy)

S2.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-31 gauge-engine increment 1: 'Crown of Wills provides additional effects: Each stack increases Augusta's Crit. Rate by 20%.' states no cap because the cap is declared on the SIBLING node S1 ('The max stack of Crown of Wills is increased to 2'). Chain levels are cumulative, so at S2 the cap IS 2. Cross-NODE cap references are out of descStackCap's reach by design (it reads one description).

trigger.phrase: Mid-air Attack Feather Release cast (her Forte finisher — NOT the plain midair_mid_air_attack; the kit names Feather Release specifically). Team ATK +20% for 20s
Casting Energized Pounce or Energized Rebound

IH1.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-05 Tier-1 override batch: 'Casting Energized Pounce or Energized Rebound increases ATK by 10% for 5s.' Both casts grant the same buff (OR).

S6.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-31 gauge-engine increment 1: 'Each stack of Endnotes on the Endgame additionally grants Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins 40% DMG Bonus, up to 120%.' pctNear() reads the first % AFTER the 'DMG Bonus' keyword and so captured the 120% CEILING as the per-stack value (1.20). The kit states 40% per stack to a 120% ceiling = 3 stacks. Stack source is Tune Break DMG dealt by teammates — unresolvable until OPEN-ITEMS #7 wires computeTuneBreakDamage.

S3.1._resolvedVia: 2026-07-05: misparse, not a self-buff at all. Full text: 'Targets hit by Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza will have their ATK reduced by 20% for 15s.' — an ENEMY ATK debuff, parsed as a self atkRatio buff. This engine doesn't model incoming-damage-taken (enemy ATK is not a resonator stat), so the effect is out of scope, not a fixable trigger/window — suppressed rather than misapplied as a +20% self ATK buff.

IH0.0._resolvedVia: 2026-07-31 gauge-engine increment 1: 'When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack Amplifies DMG by 10%, up to 30%.' → 30%/10% = 3. Stack source is the Havoc Bane count on the TARGET (enemy status, modelled in src/core/enemy-status.js but not yet wired to effect stacks), so the count stays underivable. KNOWN LIMITATION: IH0.0 (1-3 stacks) and IH0.1 (4-6 stacks) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE branches of one piecewise function, but the resolver applies both — resolving that needs the enemy-status wiring, not a cap.

IH0.1._resolvedVia: 2026-07-31 gauge-engine increment 1: 'When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack Amplifies DMG by 12%, up to 36%.' → 36%/12% = 3. See IH0.0 for the mutual-exclusion limitation.

_deferredDoc: Read by tools/effect-audit.js only (NOT merged by preprocess.mjs — these effects stay unresolved/OFF in the sim). Tracks ⚠ entries that are explicitly accepted as deferred rather than fixed, so the audit gate stays honest about what's deliberately postponed vs. what still needs a decision. Keyed deferred.<resonatorId>.<slotKey> -> reason string.

1108.S3.1: Snow Rust tiered unlock (chain modification of IH0's tiered unlock) — chain effects stay display-only per CLAUDE.md (bespoke per character, not mechanically applied), unlike IH0 itself which is now resolved via distinctApplicatorTierContribution (conditional-buffs.js), see overrides.1108.IH0.*. Deferred 2026-06-27; resolution scope narrowed 2026-06-28.
1108.S6.0: Same Snow Rust mechanic (chain modification of IH0's tiered unlock). Deferred 2026-06-27, same reason as S3.1.
1108.S6.1: Same Snow Rust mechanic (3-stack tier). Deferred 2026-06-27, same reason as S3.1.

1205.IH0.0: Fusion DMG Bonus (5%/stack of Enflamement, correctly extracted, but maxStacks not captured — should be 4, matching Enflamement's own cap) only applies to the SAME True Sight Conquest/Charge cast that's currently active, scaled by Enflamement at that moment — not a time-windowed buff. Per maintainer 2026-06-27: 'elementBonus is always global, never skill-specific — for that, skill-type-specific buffs exist', but the current schema has no 'instantaneous, scoped to the exact step that fired it, stack-scaled' bonus kind either (skillTypeBonus is duration/window-based once active, same as everything else). Needs a new resolution kind: apply only to the damage instance of the triggering cast itself. Maintainer flagged the source text as 'a bit murky' on exactly how it composes with simultaneous DMG instances. Deferred 2026-06-27.
1205.IH1.0: Same instantaneous/non-windowed gap as IH0.0 (applies only to the same Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice / Liberation cast that fires it, not a duration buff). ADDITIONALLY: the extracted value (0.15) is WRONG — pctNear() grabbed the trailing '15%' from '...ignores 15% of the target's DEF' instead of the actual '20% Fusion DMG Bonus' earlier in the same sentence (DMG Bonus keyword match position is between the two numbers; pctNear only scans forward). The DEF-ignore 15% is also an entirely separate, currently unextracted effect (a defShred-type bonus, not elementBonus) bundled in the same source sentence. Do not reuse 0.15 as the Fusion DMG Bonus value when this is eventually built — it should be 0.20, plus a new sibling DEF-ignore effect at 0.15. Deferred 2026-06-27.

1509.S3.1: Premixed Hue stacks are driven by a continuous 'Lumiflow' resource gauge (gain 1 stack/1s in combat or /0.5s out of combat while Lumiflow >= 120, lose stacks below that threshold, reset to 0 when Additive Color ends, max 25) — no time-based threshold-gated resource gauge exists in the engine. Different in kind from a discrete castMatch trigger; needs the same class of new infra as Hiyuki's Snow Rust (a continuous-resource accumulator), not a one-line override. Deferred 2026-06-27.
